context: A retired exec mentors a younger boss on people management
purpose: Teach: 上級/入試/リサーチ/ミッション/やり取り/持参/拡充/リストラ

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 上級職を相手にしたリサーチは、君のミッションだ。
lines.en: Researching upper-tier roles is your mission.
lines.style: Measured, quiet authority. Settles the words as if placing stones. A short pause before speaking — he's chosen what matters. No urgency, but weight.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 承知しております。入試世代の親も視野に入れています。
lines.en: Understood. I'm also looking at exam-generation parents as a market.
lines.style: Clear, professional assent. Clipped delivery on the commitment. Leaning forward slightly — showing he's already thinking in that direction. Respectful but not deferential.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: やり取りは丁寧に。持参資料も、最後まで責任を持て。
lines.en: Keep all interactions measured. You carry those materials — you answer for them until the end.
lines.style: Steady, firm. Each clause given equal weight. Slight emphasis on 'you' — not delegating responsibility away. Quiet but unmissable.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。組織の拡充は、人材確保とセットで考えます。
lines.en: Yes. I see org expansion and talent acquisition as one problem to solve.
lines.style: Confident, businesslike. Speaking as a peer in thought, not performing deference. Even rhythm, direct eye-contact level.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: リストラに頼らない経営、目指してくれ。
lines.en: Build a business that doesn't lean on cutting people.
lines.style: Softer than before. A slight exhale — this is the real thing he's saying. Not an order, almost a trust. Weight in the silence after.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.style: Quiet, absolute. No flourish. One breath, one moment. As if the words are going inward as much as they're spoken.
